## Description
Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI / DevOps enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the JavaScript Standard Style (`npm run lint` passes with 0 errors).
- [ ] I have executed the automated test suite (`npm test` in backend passes with 0 failures).
- [ ] I have verified that the frontend compiles cleanly (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have followed the **Zero-Placeholder Law** (no `// TODO`, `...`, or stubbed methods).
- [ ] I have added appropriate tests covering new functionality or regressions.
- [ ] I have updated documentation, environment examples, or ADRs where appropriate.
